Using a sheet pan is a game changer for batch cooking🔥 Macros Per Serving (6 Total) 548 Calories | 51g Protein | 52g Carbs | 17g Fat Ingredients (Makes 6 Servings) Chipotle Chicken Marinade - 1200g Raw Boneless Chicken Thighs, trim excess fat - 2.5 Tsp Salt - 3 Tsp Parsley - 3 Tsp Garlic Powder - 3 Tsp Smoked Paprika - 2.5 Tsp Cumin - 3 Tsp Onion Powder - 100g Chipotle Paste - 1 and 1/2 Limes, juiced - 30g or 6 Tsp Olive Oil Let this marinate overnight if possible, way more flavor! Crispy Seasoned Potatoes - 1300g Raw Yellow Potatoes, cubed - 2.5 Tsp Garlic Powder - 3 Tsp Italian Herbs - 3 Tsp Smoked Paprika - 2.5 Tsp Onion Powder - Avocado Cooking Spray, heavy pass Creamy Chipotle Sauce - 20g Light Butter - 150-200g Red Onion, finely chopped - 1.5 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Italian Herbs - 60-80g Chipotle Paste (depends how spicy you want it) - 400g Light Evaporated Milk - 110g Light Cream Cheese - Freshly Chopped Parsley, garnish 👨‍🍳 Cooking Instructions 1. Trim excess fat from chicken thighs. Add seasonings, chipotle paste, lime juice, and olive oil. Mix well and marinate. 2. Heat a large pan on low, add butter and chopped red onion. Cook for 5-7 mins until softened and lightly browned. Add seasonings and chipotle paste, mix, and cook for another 5 mins until caramelised. 3. Keep the heat low, add evaporated milk and cream cheese. Stir continuously until smooth, rich, and creamy. 4. Cube up potatoes, add seasoning and cooking spray, then mix well. Spread on a lined sheet pan and roast at 200C / 390F for 25 mins until golden and crispy. Season with salt, then fold into the sauce with fresh parsley until fully coated. 5. Spread marinated chicken on sheet pan, oven bake 25 mins 200C / 390F until golden and juicy. Cut into cubes, serve with creamy potatoes and ENJOY! . . . . #chipotle #chickenrecipes #mealprep #highprotein #healthyrecipes

Roasted Garlic Parmesan Chicken & Rice Bake🔥598 cals 62g protein 21g fat 38g carbs Ingredients: This makes 4 meals 2 lb boneless, skinless chicken breast, cubed 1 cup dry jasmine rice (185g) 2 cups low-sodium chicken broth 1 block (8oz) reduced-fat cream cheese ½ cup freshly grated parmesan cheese  1 whole garlic bulb 1 tsp olive oil Fresh parsley for garnish Seasoning blend: 2 tsp garlic powder 2 tsp Italian seasoning 2 tsp onion powder 2 tbsp smoked paprika 1 tsp salt ½ tsp black pepper Directions: 1. Preheat your oven to 400°. In a 9×13 baking dish, add your uncooked jasmine rice and chicken broth. Stir everything together and spread the rice evenly across the bottom. 2. In a large bowl, add your cubed chicken breast along with the entire seasoning blend. Toss thoroughly until every piece is evenly coated. 3. Place your seasoned chicken evenly on top of the rice mixture, keeping the tops of the chicken exposed. Slice the top off your whole garlic bulb to expose the cloves. Drizzle with olive oil and place it cut-side up alongside the chicken. Cover the dish tightly with aluminum foil. 4. Bake for 40–50 minutes, or until the rice is tender and the chicken reaches an internal temperature of 165°F. If the rice is still firm, add a splash of hot broth, cover, and continue baking until tender. 5. Remove the foil and squeeze the softened garlic cloves into the rice. Add your reduced-fat cream cheese and grated parmesan cheese, then mix everything into the hot rice until melted and creamy 6. Return to the oven uncovered for another 5–8 minutes. For a golden finish, broil for the final 1–2 minutes, watching closely. Garnish with fresh parsley, divide evenly into 6 meals, and enjoy! Honey Chipotle Chicken Wraps✨🌯🌶️ #cookingtips #recipeideas #easyrecipes #mealprep #DinnerIdeas Recipe:  Ingredients- Honey Chipotle Chicken * 4-5boneless, skinless chicken thighs, diced * 2 dollops Greek yogurt * 2 tbsp chipotle peppers in adobo sauce (blended until smooth) * Olive oil or avocado oil * 3–4 cloves garlic, minced * Onion powder * Garlic powder * Paprika * Chili powder * Cumin * Salt & pepper * Chicken bouillon * Honey (for drizzling) Homemade French Fries * 2 russet potatoes, sliced into fries * Olive oil * Salt & pepper * Garlic powder * Paprika Creamy Chipotle Sauce * ½ cup mayonnaise * 2–3 tbsp chipotle peppers in adobo sauce * Garlic powder * Juice of 1 lime * Black pepper, paprika, salt  For the Wraps * Large flour tortillas * Chopped romaine lettuce * Red onion, diced * 1 red bell pepper, diced * 1 orange bell pepper, diced * Fresh cilantro, minced * Prepared chipotle sauce Instructions 1. Prepare the chicken: Dice your chicken thighs into bite-sized pieces. In a bowl, combine Greek yogurt, blended chipotle adobo peppers, a drizzle of olive oil or avocado oil, minced garlic, onion powder, garlic powder, paprika, chili powder, cumin, salt, pepper, and chicken bouillon. Mix until the chicken is evenly coated. 2. Cook the chicken: Heat a pan with oil over medium-high heat. Add your chicken and sear until nicely browned and cooked through, reaching an internal temperature of 165°F. 3. Add the honey: Once the chicken is fully cooked, drizzle honey over the top and toss until it coats the chicken and thickens into a sticky glaze. Remove from the pan and set aside. 4. Make the fries: Slice your russet potatoes into fries and spread them onto a sheet pan. Drizzle with olive oil and season with salt, pepper, garlic powder, and paprika. Bake at 425°F for 40–45 minutes, flipping halfway through, until golden and crispy. 5. Make the chipotle sauce: In a bowl, combine mayonnaise, chipotle adobo peppers, garlic powder, freshly squeezed lime juice, and black pepper. Mix until smooth and creamy. 6. Assemble your wraps: Spread a generous amount of chipotle sauce onto a large tortilla. Add chopped romaine lettuce, honey chipotle chicken, diced red onion, red and orange bell peppers, and fresh cilantro. 7. Fold and sear: Fold your tortilla into a wrap, then place it seam-side down in a lightly oiled pan. Sear until golden and crispy on both sides. 8. Serve: Wrap in parchment paper, slice in half, and serve with your homemade fries. Drizzle extra chipotle sauce over the top or serve it on the side for dipping!
